title: Clearance Timing Reduction on Summit Miles Upgrade Co-Pays
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program reduces the co-pay of a miles upgrade that clears close to the flight. The timing is counted in calendar days from the clearance date to the flight date of the upgraded segment, as the flown coupon of that ticket and segment records it under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter.

| Clearance relative to the segment's flight date | Taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| On the day of the flight | 10 |
| 1 to 3 days before the flight | 5 |
| Any earlier clearance | None |

The reduction is taken off the co-pay to charge and never takes it below zero.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical dates, flight on 20 March):** cleared on 20 March, 10 USD off; cleared on 17 March (3 days before), 5 USD off; cleared on 16 March (4 days before), nothing off.

The clearance is the latest miles upgrade clearance on the membership, and the segment is the one that clearance names.
